courses.title: World Civilizations to 1500
courses.description: [GE 3B] From the emergence of human societies to the end of the European Renaissance. Cross-cultural study of global civilizations, their interactions with each other, their impacts, and their contributions to human civilization. Science and technology and their influences on civilizations.

courses.title: World Civilizations from 1500
courses.description: [GE 3B] World Civilizations from 1500 to the present. Cross-cultural study of global civilizations, their interactions with one another, their impacts, and their contributions to human civilization. Science and technology and their influences on civilizations. Current challenges and concerns.

courses.title: United States History to 1877 (3) [GE 4A]
courses.description: [GE 4A] [AmInst-A] History of the United States from earliest settlements to the end of Reconstruction (1877), with emphasis on the political, social, cultural, and economic trends and episodes that molded and characterized the early American nation.
